Nature does not always reinvent the wheel. What is used successfully by one virus can also be used by another and HIV certainly does not possess exclusive rights to all of its genetic sequencing. All organisms share certain amounts of similar genetic information.

Uncanny similarity of unique inserts in the 2019-nCoV spike protein to HIV-1 gp120 and Gag
